$comment: The charcoal hollow. One voice, and it is a child's, because the hollow is the one place on this road that is warm and safe and a child would be allowed to sit in it -- and because a boy repeating what the grown-ups have said, without understanding any of it, is a cleaner way to deliver the same Act 5 beat than a fifth adult saying it properly.

lines: Mam says the wood is crying. Da says do not say that to strangers.
It is not crying. It is just wet. But it is wet on the inside, which is worse.
Da says worse how, and Mam does not answer. She has stopped answering that one.
The pit has been alight since before my Mam was born. That is a hundred years.
If it goes out we have to fetch fire up from the town, and nobody has ever had to.
I am supposed to watch it. I am watching it. I am very good at it.
